title: Four-context finite-member history accounting and conditional recurrence interface
question: Does the fixed-support Q3 word and its adjoint admit exact four-context finite-member history accounting, and what four-context Cauchy coefficient follows if the explicit EXP-001151 recurrence and response hypotheses hold?

model.adjoint_static_invariance: W* changes every configuration-character amplitude sign; all kinetic fourth powers and the force l1 square are unchanged
model.finite_accounting: Each context has the EXP-001153 one-orientation squared remainder bound; the four-context squared sum is four times that value and each orientation pair pays the full triangle factor
model.conditional_recurrence: Use EXP-001151 L_x(n+1)<=(1+C*delta)L_x(n)+J*delta sum_(y~x)L_y(n) only as an explicit hypothesis
model.conditional_response: The weighted six-step factor is 31/18 and the distance-10 envelope is (31/18)^6*2^(-10)
model.product_boundary: EXP-001150 product costs remain bounded-C1 interface data and are not promoted to an unbounded history theorem
model.qft_role: This separates exact finite-member four-context bookkeeping from the unproved actual Q3 recurrence, modular response and thermodynamic limit

adversarial_review.check: The W* context is obtained by amplitude sign reversal and the exact even-power/l1 invariance is checked; no star-continuity limit is inferred.
Both real-time signs and both adjoint orientations are counted separately before any triangle or recurrence factor is applied.
Each orientation pair pays the full triangle factor; the four-context sum is not confused with a single pair.
The weighted recurrence, first response and second response are imported only as explicit conditional hypotheses from EXP-001151.
The degree-six step factor, base-minus-distance penalty and six-step count are all retained exactly.
EXP-001150 product costs are recorded but no unbounded product/core density is asserted.
No modular derivative estimate or multiplier is inserted into the four-context arithmetic.
The finite accounting is fixed-support and registered finite-member; no all-shape or volume-uniform theorem follows.
R324 checks rational context counting and conditional recurrence arithmetic only, not analytic Q3 dynamics or limits.
This interface is not common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.

lean_crosscheck.role: R324 checks exact rational context counting and conditional recurrence arithmetic only; it does not formalize the recurrence hypothesis, operator domains or thermodynamic limits.

qft_interface.closed: The fixed finite-member word has exact W/W* and plus/minus-time accounting, and the declared EXP-001151 recurrence hypothesis yields an exact four-context conditional Cauchy coefficient.
qft_interface.open: Actual Q3 recurrence, first/double commutator spatial decay, modular derivative, factorial histories, volume-uniform direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, group law, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing four-context finite-member accounting plus conditional recurrence interface. It computes a consequence of explicit hypotheses and does not prove those hypotheses.
next_action: Attack the actual Q3 four-context recurrence and first/double response on the bounded cylinder algebra; require source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform constants before promoting the conditional coefficient to direct Cauchy.
no_overclaim: Only finite-member four-context arithmetic and conditional recurrence bookkeeping are closed. No actual Q3 recurrence, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result is claimed.
